Class TemporalMapTensorManager

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.TemporalMapTensorManager
public class TemporalMapTensorManager extends Object
High-Performance Temporal Cartographic Tensor Manager. Resolves, caches, and seamlessly interpolates planetary raster maps across geological, paleoclimatic (-100,000 BP to 0), and historical/industrial epochs (1800 to 2026+). Dedicated storage: data/maps/ether///.png

      public static javafx.scene.image.Image loadTemporalMapImage(String planet, long requestedYear, String layerName)
      Loads a temporal map image for a given planet, requested year, and layer. Performs automatic temporal fallback, causal forward step transitions for historical/epidemiological events, or continuous bilinear cross-epoch interpolation for physical fields.
